messages:
maya: Heads-up — seeing a ~$28k spike in GPU hours for March that landed under the `platform` cost center but it should be `research`. Likely untagged experimental clusters (experimental-sim). Can we reallocate before we close the books?

raj: I can look into it. Do you have a list of instance IDs or a billing export row sample?

maya: attaching a quick sample from billing export: `resource_name: projects/redwood-prod/zones/us-west1-a/instances/exp-sim-23` and the usage_id `usage_20240315_0812`. There are ~14 similar instances.

david: Finance needs the full set and the dollar amounts per instance. We can do a journal entry but prefer a clean cost-transfer on next invoice. If backfill is possible in the billing export (BQ), we can generate a transfer file.

maya: I can pull the BQ rows and share a CSV. Quick query I used: ```SELECT invoice_month, resource_name, cost, labels FROM `redwood-billing.gcp_export.gcp_billing_export_v1_*` WHERE invoice_month = '2024-03' AND resource_name LIKE '%exp-sim%'```

raj: Perfect. I can also backfill the `labels.cost_center` for those instances if we have the instance list. That will ensure future runs are attributed correctly.

soraya: FYI — the test infra provisioning script wasn't populating `labels.cost_center` because the terraform module ignored env var on ephemeral clusters. PR #482 fixes it; deployed to staging yesterday.

raj: Nice. I'll run a tag backfill script against the prod instances after you share the list. Command I'll run: `gcloud compute instances add-labels EXP_INSTANCE --labels=cost_center=research --project=redwood-prod` (iterated over the list).

maya: Uploaded CSV to /finance/internal/gpu-backfill-2024-03.csv and added a link in the thread: <https://internal.redwood/s3/finance/gpu-backfill-2024-03.csv>

ops-bot: Billing export ingestion completed for 2024-03 at 03:12UTC — 7,214 resource rows processed. :white_check_mark:

raj: Running backfill now. Will post ETA.

david: Once backfill is done, finance needs a mapping: original invoice line(s) -> new cost center allocation -> dollar amounts. Also need approval for transfer method: (A) adjust next invoice via credit, (B) manual journal entry. Preference: invoice credit if vendor allows.

raj: Backfill done — updated labels on 14 instances. I also added a note to the instance metadata `backfill_by=raj on 2024-04-03`. Command log: ```for id in $(cat list.txt); do gcloud compute instances add-labels $id --labels=cost_center=research; done```

maya: Thanks. CSV updated with `post_backfill_cost_center` column. Total moved: $27,943.17.

david: Confirming amount. I'll open a transfer request ticket with accounting and ping vendor billing. Need CFO approval for invoice credit vs journal. Tagging alice. @alice any preference?

alice: Approve invoice credit if vendor supports it. If not, do manual journal and mark as cost transfer to Research for March. Go ahead.

maya: Great — setting status: finance-actionable. I've added the `cost-transfer` ticket: FIN-2024-1123 and attached the CSV.

david: Created vendor ticket referencing FIN-2024-1123 asking for credit for March reallocation. Also creating internal journal entry draft in NetSuite in case vendor declines.

soraya: Also re-deployed the terraform module change to prod to prevent future misses. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/terraform/merge/482

raj: Reopen if anything else. I'll add an alert in infra: if an instance is provisioned without `labels.cost_center` we'll send a warning to #eng-ops and block auto-scaling for that pool.

maya: Thanks everyone. I'll close the loop once vendor responds and finance completes the transfer. :v:
